description: Which planets and the Moon can be observed tonight from a place, and when: windows above a minimum altitude while the sky is dark, with the best time, altitude, azimuth and magnitude. E.g. {date: '2026-06-21', latitude: 48.8566, longitude: 2.3522}. For observation planning: over the night that starts on 'date' (local noon to noon), the intervals when each body stands at least min_altitude_deg above the horizon while the Sun is at or below sun_altitude_max_deg (default -6: after civil dusk), each with start, end, duration and the best moment (highest altitude) with its azimuth and visual magnitude; plus the dark interval itself. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.02 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/visibility (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.

bodies.description: Bodies to plan. Default: the Moon and Mercury..Neptune.

date.description: The evening that starts the observing night, YYYY-MM-DD: the night runs from local noon on that date to local noon the next day.

elevation_m.description: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres (no terrain or horizon dip is modelled).

min_altitude_deg.description: Lowest useful altitude of the body above the horizon, degrees.

sun_altitude_max_deg.description: The sky counts as dark when the Sun is at or below this altitude: -6 civil, -12 nautical, -18 astronomical.

timezone.description: IANA zone for local times, e.g. 'Europe/Paris'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates (with its historical DST rules).

name: observation_windows

accepts.description: x402 offer only: the payment options (scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, ...).

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

error.description: x402 offer only: why payment is required.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

resource.description: x402 offer only: the resource being paid for.

bodies.description: One row per body: visible, total_minutes, max_altitude and windows [{start, end, duration_minutes, best: {utc, local, timestamp, altitude, azimuth, magnitude}}].

dark.description: The intervals when the Sun is at or below sun_altitude_max_deg: [{start, end}].

settings.description: The bodies, min_altitude_deg, sun_altitude_max_deg, the sampling step and every convention.

subject.description: The place, its time zone, the date and the night's window in UTC (local noon to noon).

title: Observation windows for a night
